# AORMS

AORMS (Accelerated Operational Resources Management System) is a **cloud-based
office management system** for architecture practices and consultancies —
web-only, single unified app, pure architectural consultancy (not
engineering, not multi-discipline AEC).

AORMS is NOT contractor ERP and NOT a full Primavera/MSP replacement.
**AORMS Office Hub** is the office management hub (clients, projects,
proposals, invoices, team, finances, knowledge bank). **ESTI** is the
built-in AI agent for office automation and insights, running self-hosted
(Ollama) alongside the cloud backend. There are no desktop apps, no
installers, and no allied products — everything lives in the one web app.

Home: https://aorms.in/
Blog: https://aorms.in/blog
Login: https://aorms.in/login

## Product notes
- Single unified web app — no desktop apps, no per-app installers, no
  separate product logins
- IBM Carbon Design System across the app and marketing/landing pages
- Client, consultant, and contractor portals show published data only
